scope: Actual extracted final ZIP, provided Python launcher, fresh Chromium context, opening, movement, first ordinary story action, saved export and exact reload. Not whole-game verification.
checks: Provided launcher serves the extracted current Mercy build on 127.0.0.1 and the 3D opening loads.
Actual keyboard movement changes Blaise position and leaves the encountered run exactly unchanged.
First ordinary story action saves, replays against exact current content, and survives reload/takeover with an identical complete export.
All observed runtime HTTP requests stay on the local launcher; external HTTP requests were blocked and none were attempted.
limits: Python 3 available in this workspace; no Windows/macOS installation test
No human playtest, duration or hardware performance claim
